endorsements.name: Quentin Meffre
endorsements.label: Escaping the Safari Sandbox: A Tour of Webkit IPC
endorsements.description: In 2023 Apple fixed a full-chain which used a vulnerability in the WebKit GPU process to escape the WebContent sandbox and compromise an iPhone. After this attack, a lot of new security hardening have been introduced to kill the exploitation methods and reduce even more the WebContent attack surface. Read more
